scope: Read-only script and installed Python tarfile implementation; no network, acquisition script execution or compiler tree inspection by reviewer

Full header traversal rejects normalized escapes, duplicate paths and special files. Per-member data_filter and final strict symlink containment add checks. Source review and helper controls do not establish actual compiler/SDK/prover compatibility.
